AdminSuperSandbox.title: Simulador de sorteo
AdminSuperSandbox.description: Mismo flujo que un sorteo real: primero se publica el compromiso (hash de la semilla) y después se ejecutan los premios con la semilla revelada y las huellas. Podés elegir hasta 10.000 números y 50 premios; cada premio tiene su hash y hay un results_hash combinado. Nada de esto aparece en la web pública ni modifica sorteos reales.

AdminSuperBajas.title: Account deletions
AdminSuperBajas.description: The user requests deletion from their profile. Here it is approved or rejected with a reason. Approving deletes personal data and KYC documents; payments and refunds remain recorded without a name.

AdminSuperSandbox.title: Draw simulator
AdminSuperSandbox.description: Same flow as a real draw: first the commitment is published (seed hash), then prizes run with the revealed seed and fingerprints. You can choose up to 10,000 numbers and 50 prizes; each prize has its hash and there is a combined results_hash. None of this appears on the public site or changes real raffles.
